units.source_text: 杜子春不由自主的捂住了耳朵，趴在岩石上。

en.t: Toshishun instinctively covered his ears and lay flat on the rock.

units.source_text: 可是，等他睁开眼睛再看时，天空又恢复如初，万里无云了，

en.t: But when he opened his eyes and looked again, the sky had returned to its former state, cloudless for ten thousand miles,

units.source_text: 高耸的山峰上面，北斗星遥挂天上，熠熠生辉。

en.t: Above the towering mountain peak, the Big Dipper hung far away in the sky, shining brilliantly.

units.source_text: 这么一看，看来刚才的疾风骤雨、猛虎巨蟒一定都是魔障们发现铁冠子不在，捉弄自己的恶作剧了。

en.t: Seeing this, he realized that the fierce wind and sudden rain, the savage tiger, and the giant python just now must all have been tricks played on him by the demons after they noticed Tieguanzi was gone.

units.source_text: 杜子春心定了下来，抬袖拭了拭汗，继而继续端坐在岩石上。

en.t: Toshishun calmed down, raised his sleeve to wipe away his sweat, and then continued sitting upright on the rock.
